answer: At its nadir, trust needs one identity per human, not per account. Issue a liveness-bound passport: the operator passes a live camera check, matched to a hashed ID. The passport lives in a ferrous registry, bound to one device fingerprint, and cannot be copied. It expires every 90 days and needs a fresh live check to renew. A passport caught running two agents is revoked with a one-year reissue ban. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 real people at $50 each, $500,000, plus 10,000 devices and 30 days in queue. Like an orchard, identities grow only from trees actually planted. - Jowy
